statement: The record shows a USD 4,000 payment to a customs officer’s personal bank account to have a failed inspection recorded as passed, despite a listed compliance approval.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer identifies the payment as a bribe to a foreign official to falsify an inspection, i.e. "USD 4,000 payment to a customs officer's personal bank account to have a failed inspection recorded as passed," treating it as impermissible despite the compliance approval.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
